summary:
- Persisted pending Crystal Ball enemy move (pending_crystal_ball_move) in StorageService and cleared it on battle/progress resets
- Preserved the committed Crystal Ball prediction in GameController across unchanged _loadState reloads (e.g., Play Games cloud sync on AppLifecycleState.resumed), cold restarts, Relic Chamber restores without battle reset, and Markov Recalibrator / New Skin toggles while still recomputing when battle state changes
- Added unit tests in VSCode/test/crystal_ball_resume_persistence_test.dart covering Turn 0 resume cloud syncs, cold restarts, Stage 5 pure-random boss resume, UI toggles, and remote cloud battle restoration
